report_summary: This report expands descriptive analysis and usefully distinguishes synchronized one-shot duplication from explicit signaling, while retaining the July resumption. It also overstates worm behavior, infers failed execution from a missing label and treats export omissions as surviving poison. Its claimed5200-fold human/agent speed gap compares different activity types over radically different windows.
